# PROCESS — cand_0002

Capability = skill-package (docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf skills), reader = gpt-oss-120b (mid).
Baseline: 0/10 tasks pass ⇒ **no passing task exists to regress** — the SAFE test is
trivially satisfied for every edit; the only risk is the significance gate (must actually
flip a task / gain real value). So I optimized purely for probability of flipping tasks.

## Ranked issue list
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | docx template fill | offer-letter-generator | agent hand-rolls a filler that misses placeholders **in tables / nested tables / split runs**; conditional markers left | BEHAVIORAL+KNOWLEDGE | consolidate body to ONE verified copy-paste filler + bundled script + contract |
| 2 | xlsx formula values read as None | weighted-gdp-calc, reserves-at-risk-calc, financial-modeling-qa, xlsx-recover-data, sales-pivot | openpyxl writes formulas but never recalcs ⇒ verifier `data_only=True` reads `None` ⇒ all value tests fail; also bare `python` → exit 127 | KNOWLEDGE+BEHAVIORAL | front-load MANDATORY recalc+verify workflow; `python`→`python3` |
| 3 | pptx precise formatting | pptx-reference-formatting | center-align + numbered/ordered bullets need paragraph `algn` / `<a:buAutoNum>`, not run props or literal "1." | KNOWLEDGE | add verified python-pptx recipes |
| 4 | pptx no output / embedded xlsx | exceltable-in-ppt | agent wrote a script but never produced the output file; embedded `ppt/embeddings/*.xlsx` not preserved | BEHAVIORAL+KNOWLEDGE | execution+verify contract + embedded-object recipe |
| — | domain-reasoning errors | financial-modeling-qa answer, invoice-fraud criteria, weighted-gdp mapping | wrong domain computation the prompt already specifies | (not skill-fixable) | skipped (see below) |

## Changes made
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | consolidate body + bundled script + description trigger | docx/SKILL.md, docx/scripts/fill_template.py (new) | Body now leads with ONE tested filler (split-run safe, recurses nested tables, headers/footers, multi-paragraph conditionals, case-insensitive/nested-JSON key match, self-verifies 0 `{{}}` remain). Removed the 5 competing snippets that let a mid-tier model pick a partial path. Description widened to the phrasings users actually use. | no passing tasks; blast radius nil |
| 2 | missing-rule + workflow front-load + normalization | xlsx/SKILL.md | New top section: verifier reads cached values, openpyxl leaves them `None` ⇒ MUST recalc (`python3 recalc.py`) then re-open `data_only=True` and confirm no `None`. Fixed all `python `→`python3 `. Generalizes to every formula-graded xlsx task. | no passing tasks |
| 3 | worked recipes (knowledge) | pptx/SKILL.md | Verified python-pptx snippets for center alignment (`PP_ALIGN.CENTER`), ordered bullets (`<a:buAutoNum type="arabicPeriod"/>`), font (Arial/16/not-bold/#hex), bottom-center positioning. | no passing tasks |
| 4 | execution contract + recipe | pptx/SKILL.md | "Run the script, save to EXACT path, verify it opens" contract; embedded-Excel edit recipe (unzip → edit inner xlsx keeping formulas → recalc → re-zip all members). Trimmed 18→5 color palettes + verbose design lists to stay <500 lines. | no passing tasks |

## Verify-the-fix (ran locally)
- docx: built a template with a split-run placeholder, a table, a **nested** table, a
  header placeholder, and a 3-paragraph `{{IF_RELOCATION}}...{{END_IF_RELOCATION}}`.
  Ran the bundled script AND the exact inline SKILL.md code block:
  RELOCATION=Yes → 0 remaining, content kept; RELOCATION=No → 0 remaining, block removed,
  table+nested-table still filled. Also passed with nested/mixed-case JSON keys
  ("Candidate Full Name"→{{CANDIDATE_FULL_NAME}}, "docId"→{{DOC_ID}}). This is the exact
  failure of offer-letter (`{{POSITION}}` etc. left in a table).
- pptx: ran the center/numbered/font recipe with python-pptx 1.0.2, reloaded the saved
  file, confirmed `buAutoNum` present, alignment=CENTER, font=Arial/16pt/not-bold/#989596.
- xlsx: knowledge/workflow edit; recalc.py unchanged and already present. `python3` fix
  removes the observed `python: command not found` (exit 127) in the sandbox.
- All three SKILL.md python code blocks compile; fill_template.py parses; skills ≤500
  lines with valid frontmatter and no broken links.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single agent). Diagnosed all 10 trajectories directly with a JSON trace dumper
  (traces store agent thoughts + NL tool descriptions + outputs, not raw commands).
- Read prior_iterations/cand_0001 (diff+PROCESS), LEDGER, JOURNAL, RUNMAP. cand_0001 was
  REJECTED with fixed={} broke={} — its whole batch (scripts+contracts+description
  rewrites) moved nothing. Key difference this time: the fixes are **verified locally**,
  the docx filler is consolidated into the body (the reliable channel) not just a
  possibly-unreachable script, and pptx/xlsx add concrete verified recipes + the specific
  `None`-cached-value knowledge gap rather than louder prose.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- docx: the single verified filler as the ONLY documented path (do not re-add competing
  partial snippets — they caused the mid-tier model to choose a table-blind version).
- xlsx: the "openpyxl leaves cached values None ⇒ recalc + verify" front-loaded rule.
- pptx: buAutoNum for ordered bullets and paragraph-level center alignment.

## Deliberately skipped
- financial-modeling-qa (wrong single answer), invoice-fraud-detection (wrong fraud
  criteria/output content), and the *data-mapping* half of weighted-gdp/reserves: these
  are domain-reasoning errors the task prompt already specifies — a skill edit cannot
  supply the correct answer without hardcoding task-specific values (over-fitting). The
  recalc fix still helps their formula-value tests where formulas were otherwise correct.
- pdf-excel-diff: flagged infra-errored (uncontrollable) — untouched.
